validation_notes: Processed 13 unique people from 15 SVCB CSV rows; Dmitry Gusev and Dmitry Khotimskiy appeared twice because each had executive and board roles. Checked 4 local SVCB documents: annual report, corporate-governance-code report, related-party transactions report, and IFRS financial statements. Completed one research round per person, 13 person-rounds total. Local official 2024 documents confirm governance structure, board size and executive-body structure but intentionally do not disclose most personal biographies due restrictions described in the KKU report. Weak or partially extractable sources were used for Cherstvova, Klyukin, Varma, Braverman, Fleming, Lautier and Bondarovich; these are flagged in person notes. Namesakes were checked through company/role anchors; no academic-author or unrelated-profile facts were promoted without company linkage. Remaining conflict: official local 2024 sources hide names while CSV and external governance sources supply names, so the final board/person mapping is treated as soft-validated rather than fully official. QUALITY PASS 2026-08-01 (round 1, see research_notes/SVCB/quality_pass_round1_20260801.md for full detail): Step 0 baseline check against git HEAD found no regression (all notes, descriptions and source citations matched or exceeded the committed baseline) before any edits were made. Simple-omission desyncs fixed: qualification_degree filled for 11 education/degree entries across Gusev, Khotimskiy, Cherstvova, Avtukhov, Kuchment, Klyukin and Bondarovich, either directly from an already-cited fact (Khotimskiy's MSU entry) or from high-confidence context inference (Russian pre-Bologna Specialist-degree era, or Doctoral degree for Gusev's Kandidat nauk) per REFINEMENT.md's context-inference policy; 14 Sovcombank self-employer professional_experience entries plus Otkritie, Deloitte, Coopers & Lybrand/PwC, Hoff, AT&T and MTS entries received GICS sector/industry_group/industry that had been left all-null despite unambiguous employer identity. GICS label-correctness fixes: (1) Joel Lautier's 'Chess / FIDE public profile trail' identity-disambiguation entry had been wrongly tagged Industrials/Transportation/Ground Transportation -- reset to all-null (not a classifiable commercial organization); (2) Elena Cherstvova's bundled 'Поволжский немецкий банк / GE Money Bank / Министерство регионального развития РФ' entry had been tagged Financials/Banks/Banks even though one of the three named organizations is a federal government ministry -- split into a bank entry (kept Banks) and a ministry entry (GICS nulled, correctly non-classifiable). Bounded gap follow-ups (fresh queries not tried in round 1, one attempt each): education FOUND and added for Pavel Barchugov (Plekhanov Russian Economic Academy 1995, plus a new 2013 Sberbank role), Anatoly Braverman (ICEF/HSE 2006 Bachelor's, plus LUKOIL/Gazprom Neft/RDIF/RVK career), Mikhail Kuchment's MIPT qualification (физик-исследователь, plus new Samsung Electronics/M.Video career entries), and Joel Lautier (Skolkovo MBA 2014, plus RGG Capital/Yevropeyskaya Elektrotechnika/Sintez-OKA/Russian Magnesium roles, all via Sovcombank's own 2020 appointment press release also used for Regina von Fleming's newly-added Axel Springer/Hurriyet/Delta Capital/Krone AG/MTS/Chelpipe roles); education for Nikolay Narayan Varma, Aleksey Fisun (patronymic Leonidovich confirmed instead) and Regina von Fleming remained unresolved after fresh queries and are logged in person notes so a future pass tries different angles. GENUINE INCONSISTENCY investigated and documented: Joel Lautier's CSV-anchored 'ongoing board member' status conflicts with an external, dated, named-newspaper-sourced resignation (25 February 2022, per Wikipedia/Les Echos); after cross-checking against Sovcombank's own press release and several generic (likely stale) data-aggregator profiles, end_year 2022 was added to his Sovcombank professional_experience entry while current_role was deliberately left unchanged (anchored to this corpus's CSV-based convention) -- the conflict is documented, not silently resolved either way. No previously confirmed fact, description, note, source citation or correctly-non-classifiable null was deleted or shortened in this round.
